sentence: Competitive intensity strengthens the creational path from technological opportunism to competitive advantage [CITE], and the efficiency gains of the corpus's null-baseline study need, among other conditions, sharper competitive pressure
passage: [Kazakis (2026), abstract] "The heterogeneity analysis indicates that efficiency gains materialize primarily when firms pair AI with capable managers, face stronger competitive pressure, have more stable institutional investor ownership, and are able to secure long-term debt."

gemini.overclaim: Competitive intensity strengthens the creational path from technological opportunism to competitive advantage
gemini.note: The passage confirms that efficiency gains require stronger competitive pressure, but it does not discuss technological opportunism or a creational path to competitive advantage.
